title: Range Add, Point Query
prompt:
**Bài toán.** Zero-initialized array of size n, q operations:
`1 l r v` adds v to [l, r]; `2 p` prints a[p].

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n, q ≤ 200 000; |v| ≤ 10^9; answers fit in long long.

tests.name: overlapping adds
negative add
n=200000 bulk adds
tests.hint: 10^5 whole-range adds of +1 then 10^5 point reads of position 7: every answer is 100000.
